description: Make an original instrumental song from a description: genre, mood, instruments, tempo, what it's for. Returns it queued; the player in the chat shows it rendering and plays it when it's done (about a minute), with MP3 and WAV downloads and its five stems (drums, bass, guitar, keys, other) as FLAC. Where there's no player, get_song gives those links once it's done. Artist names are not allowed and are removed from prompts before generation: describe the sound instead. Royalty-free, for commercial games and videos. It makes sound effects too, with nothing to switch: a description with no music in it ("heavy rain on a tin roof", "a sword clashing against a metal shield") comes back as a sound effect, one take up to 30 seconds with MP3 and WAV and no stems, and its kind is "sfx". It can follow a chord chart (chords), score a picture (picture), and take a reference track's tempo and key (reference); the prompt is optional with a picture or a plan_id. To show the person what you'll make first, call plan_song with the same fields, then create_song with its plan_id.

bpm.description: Tempo; left out, it's chosen from the prompt.

chords.description: A chord chart the parts follow. Bars, one chord a bar: "| Am | F | C | G |" (or "Am F C G"), "%" to repeat a bar, "x2" at the end to play it twice. Or the progression in words: "a 12-bar blues in A", "a ii-V-I in C minor". It goes round to fill the song's length. Chords are kept as written; the parts play each in its nearest plain form (G7b9 as G7, G13 as G7), and the answer says which. A progression in the prompt's words is read too.

key.description: A note with sharps and major or minor, like "C major" or "F# minor".

like.description: The id of one of the person's songs for this one to sit beside (the next theme of a soundtrack, this week's music for a channel): it takes that song's tempo and key, unless bpm or key say otherwise.

loop.description: A seamless loop, for a game level or a background.

picture.description: A picture to score: the music is made for what it shows (place, light, mood, pace). With no prompt, the picture alone is the brief; with one, the words win where they say something. ChatGPT hands an attached image this way; any other agent sends { download_url }.

download_url.description: Where to fetch the image (https, JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP, at most 5 MB).

plan_id.description: A plan from plan_song (kept an hour): makes exactly that plan, as shown. Send it alone, with seed or variations if you like.

prompt.description: The music in words, e.g. "a calm village theme with flute and harp", or a sound with no music in it for a sound effect, e.g. "footsteps on gravel". Optional with a picture or a plan_id.

reference.description: A reference track: the song takes its tempo and key (measured from the audio) unless the request or its words name their own. It doesn't copy the track's sound, rhythm or melody.

download_url.description: Where to fetch the track (https, MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC or OGG, at most 25 MB).

seed.description: Makes the same song again from the same words and settings; left out, a new one each time.

variations.description: How many versions of it to make (default 1). Two count as one song.

name: create_song
title: Make a song
